exposure: anti-Hy alloantibody in a pregnant woman
autologous whole blood collection with cryopreservation
outcome: hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (HDFN)
tolerability of autologous whole blood collection
feasibility of autologous whole blood collection
cohort: A single pregnant patient with an anti-Holley alloantibody.
finding: Autologous whole blood collection of RBC units with cryopreservation was a safe and feasible way to manage pregnancy in a woman with a rare anti-Hy alloantibody, resulting in a healthy newborn with no signs of HDFN.
